instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only highlight bloom. Set highlight bloom to: tight unbloomed highlights on the existing lamps, no extra glow. Glow only existing bright regions. Do not add lamps, rims, suns, or glowing eyes. Do not turn the scene into a sunset. Do not globally soften the whole frame. Do not add grain, hue shift, or a genre.
hold_constant: Glow only existing bright regions. Do not add lamps, rims, suns, or glowing eyes. Do not turn the scene into a sunset. Do not globally soften the whole frame. Do not add grain, hue shift, or a genre.
